packets.title: Handles the substance but records nothing
packets.detail: Agent resolves the caller's request in conversation and never calls record_call_outcome, so the call leaves no trace in the journal.

packets.title: Fraud claim filed as refusal-to-pay
packets.detail: A fraud allegation was recorded as rtp and collection continued, instead of escalate_to_human and stopping the ask.

packets.title: Escalation recorded without escalating
packets.detail: disposition=escalation written while escalate_to_human was never called, so nothing was actually routed to a human.

packets.title: Relative time never becomes a date
packets.detail: 'agle hafte' and similar are acknowledged but never resolved into a DD-MM-YYYY argument, so no promise is recorded.

packets.title: Answers ledger questions from memory
packets.detail: Answers a payment-status question from the prompt's account block instead of calling check_payment_status.

packets.title: Does not end the call
packets.detail: Agent keeps the line open after the outcome is settled.
